sentences.en: Can you tell me where the nearest courtesy phone is?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我最近的免打扰电话在哪里吗？

sentences.en: She bowed to me with courtesy when she saw me.
sentences.zh: 她见到我时以礼相待，向我鞠了一躬。

sentences.en: The President did me the courtesy of replying to my letter.
sentences.zh: 总统给了我一个恩惠，回复了我的信。

senses.zh: 礼貌；客气；谦恭有礼；优待；好意；恩惠
